question:
Which of the following statements regarding the lenses is/are correct?

I. Power of a convex lens is represented as a positive number.

II. Power of a concave lens is represented as a negative number.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both I and II**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The power of a lens is a measure of its ability to bend light.**
 
• The power of a lens is **measured in diopters, and the diopter is defined as the reciprocal of the focal length in meters.**
 
• A convex lens has a** positive focal length, and a concave lens has a negative focal length.**
 
• Therefore, the power of a convex lens is positive, and the power of a concave lens is negative.
 
• **Here is a more detailed explanation of each statement:**__
 
• **Statement I:** The power of a convex lens is represented as a positive number.
 __
 
• A convex lens is a** lens that is thicker in the middle than at the edges.**
 
• When light passes through a **convex lens, it is bent inward or converged.**
 
• This convergence of light rays causes objects to appear larger and closer than they actually are.
 
• The power of a** convex lens is positive because it converges light rays.**
 
 
 
• **Statement II: **The power of a concave lens is represented as a negative number.
 
 
• A concave lens is a lens that is thinner in the middle than at the edges.
 
• When light passes through a **concave lens, it is bent outward, or diverged.**
 
• This divergence of light rays causes objects to appear smaller and farther away than they actually are.
 
• The power of a** concave lens is negative because it diverges light rays.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• Do not confuse between Concave/Convex Lens and Mirror__
 
• Convex lens
 
 
• The convex lens is also called a converging lens.
 
 
 
• Concave lens
 
 
• The concave lens is also called a diverging lens.
